reviews.text: They're so kind to my little chonker.

I can't say enough good things about the team here. My dog Chanel recently had surgery to remove three bumps, along with a teeth cleaning, and everything went extremely well. She bounced back in no time and was back to her usual self within just a couple of hours.

From the first consultation to pickup and follow-up, the staff were caring, professional, and kept me informed every step of the way. It made a stressful experience so much easier knowing she was in such good hands. I couldn't be happier with how they took care of her from beginning to end.

I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a vet who truly cares about their animals. Thank you, Dr. Harmeet, for taking such great care of Chanel!
Karina, thank you for your support! Our team truly appreciates your trust and the opportunity to care for your pet! 🐾 😍 …
Christine, thank you for your support! Our team truly appreciates your trust and the opportunity to care for your pet! 🐾 😍 …

Dr. Bick is truly the best. He's warm, patient, and clearly cares about the animals he treats. Our maltipoo Amalfi was completely at ease with him. He takes the time to explain things properly, never makes you feel rushed, and gives straightforward, honest advice. You walk out feeling like your pet is in really good hands. If you're going to Toronto Veterinary Clinic, ask for Dr. Bick. We won't see anyone else now!!

Doctor Harmeet and all the staff here have been so caring and helpful with explaining all the options for Alfie's medical needs. No pressure, no sales tactics - just thoughtful clear communication and quality care.
Brought Crush in on very short notice and received the quality care we've come to expect.  Wouldn't take my cats anywhere else.

My maltipoo hasn't been feeling well, so I brought her into this clinic, where she's been a patient since day one. I've seen a few of the doctors here, but I had to write this review for Dr. Bick. His care and knowledge go beyond anything I've experienced with any other vet. There were moments after our appointment when I panicked and called the clinic, and every time he either responded or called me back right away. You won't find another doctor like him. Thank you so much, Dr. Bick. You're truly one of one, and I'm so happy we found you.
I really enjoyed the experience. Everyone who assisted us was very cordial and polite. The kittens felt loved.

I just called to inquire about the " dogs grooming" service stated under their services and they said they do not have that.  So why even have it listed?  Well that was time I will never get back.  Thank you for wasting it.
Thanks for the 5 stars! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …
Thank you so much Mike! We appreciate the 5 star rating :)

Had a very good experience in my first visit to TVC. The Veterinarian, Bick, who attended my dog was very thorough and spent time with us going over my dog's background and issues. I didn't feel rushed and thought that he cared about my concerns, which I haven't felt with other vets. Very happy so far!

Last Saturday, my dog had an emergency, and I called this clinic. They were extremely indifferent and told me they didn’t even have time to see my dog. They said nothing could be done, and even when I asked if they could wait a bit longer, they still didn’t accept us. From the very first day this clinic opened, I was their patient. I have always gone there myself and recommended them to everyone. After all these years—I’ve been bringing my dog, but neither they know my dog nor do they know me. They have no relationship with their patients; it all just seems like a business to them. This is where I went to Marine Parade Veterinary, and even though I wasn’t their patient, I saw how welcomed I was and how they went beyond and above to help me. This is where you really see the difference between the two vets. We have so many other vets in this area who can provide much better care. If you are trying to build a relationship between you, your dog, and your vet, this is not the right place to go. And just to mention this was not the first time they easily refused to see my dog for an emergency

Updated review to reiterate that all staff, the vets/front desk/technicians/literally every person we talked to, are so friendly and helpful! I greatly appreciate how thorough and detailed the appointment was. As well, the additional info of closest emergency clinic for the holidays is greatly appreciated. It is very clear how much everyone at this clinic cares for their furry patients.
I was so afraid that when we moved 2 years ago I'd have a hard time finding a new vet. I'm so glad to have found Toronto Veterinary Clinic!!
They were very accommodating for a last minute need!
Kind and gentle staff. Knowledgeable and honest vet. Highly recommended.
Very friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommended 👌 …
Always very kind and looking out  for my pups health! Thank you guys, appreciate you.

Dr. Bick is always so patient and gentle with my senior dog, Molly. I truly appreciate the time he takes to answer all my questions and concerns regarding her health.
We’re so grateful for him and the wonderful staff at Toronto Veterinary Clinic!

All the times I came, team were so friendly, helpful and understandable for Lo kind of situations. Clients of this clinic almost 4 years.
Recommend!!!!

12 thousand dollars for an xray of the stomach is absolutely insane for a 25 pound dog. She said the initial exam visit is 90 something dollars and the xray is 12,000.  I will be going everywhere else but here

EDIT: I called in and asked roughly how much it would cost to have a xray of my dogs stomach, without hesitation the lady that answered the phone said “12 thousand dollars plus the initial visit of 90 something” I replied with “12 thousand dollars??” And she said yes” maybe she was confused between thousand and hundred but that’s not really a mistake I’m willing to deal with later.
Mariia, thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🐾 …
Toronto Veterinary Clinic is Great. Always willing to accommodate and does what is in best in the interest of your pet. They do not upsell and are patient with your questions.
Everything well organized, doctor and assistants are very nice and friendly. I also like the clinic's way of announcing pre-scheduled appointments and vaccination dates. Thank you
Awesome vet clinic, highly recommended

I recently switched vets to Toronto Veterinary Clinic with Dr. Harmeet, and I’m so glad I did. I originally chose the clinic because of the great reviews, and the care we’ve received has been even better than I hoped.

Dr. Harmeet is incredibly thorough, knowledgeable, kind, and easy to talk to. They’re also very accommodating and have always managed to fit us in within a day or two when something urgent comes up, which gives me a lot of peace of mind. The vet techs are also wonderful. They’re kind, gentle, and genuinely loving with my dog, which makes a big difference.

One thing that really stood out was my dog’s skin infection. Our previous vet had diagnosed it as an allergy, but Dr. Harmeet recognized that it was actually an infection and that antibiotics were needed. Once it was properly treated, it made such a difference and saved my dog a lot of discomfort.

I also find the pricing for appointments to be very reasonable compared with other veterinary clinics I’ve used. Overall, I’m really happy we made the switch. I feel confident that my dog is in good hands here, and I would absolutely recommend Dr. Harmeet and Toronto Veterinary Clinic to other pet owners.

The most recent visit with Quincy went very well. The wait was not long at all. Q and I felt welcomed.
Dr. Harmeet was patient with Quincy. The vet tech was kind and patient too. All of the staff were given his age of 16.5 years. When asked I would definitely recommend this vet clinic.
Thanks for the 5 stars, Rose! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …

We always leave Toronto Veterinary Clinic feeling informed and reassured, with all of our questions answered. Having a dog with a complex medical condition isn't easy, but Dr. Harmeet Jassal always takes the time to provide exceptional care for our dog while patiently answering our many questions. We're incredibly grateful for his compassion, expertise, and dedication.

A wonderful experience.

Kind knowledgable veterinarians, very nice staff willing to go the extra mile with a smile!

Reasonable prices. Very clean offices. I appreciate that they’re family owned and totally locally owned.

I'm glad I found this clinic.
Thank you guys !!!

More like 7 stars!!! We LOVE Toronto Vet' Clinic. have taken our dog, Alfie, for 3 years now.  Yesterday was just another great example of caring, attentive and thorough care given - on extremely short notice. Reasonably priced, excellent care and great follow-up.

For the past years we’ve tried multiple Veterinarians within the GTA, so far we’ve had great results at the Toronto Veterinary Clinic. Both Dr.Bick and Dr Harmeet are very knowledgeable, they take their time in the consultations and are very helpful. They both provide options on how to move forward with medications or different pathways. My dog has a very specific situation, Dr Bick made sure to consult the hospital, to ensure that the medication that was provided for his ear infection was safe for his condition. Dr Harmeet also performed an ultrasound on spot to ensure that everything was well with my dog, going the extra step. We find the environment professional, attentive and overall very caring. Thank you so much !
Dante, we truly appreciate the support! 🐾 …
Sneha, thank you for the support! We love caring for your pets!

I completely trust Dr. Jassal with my Chloe. He truly cares about his patients and always recommends the care that is genuinely in their best interest. The entire staff at Toronto Veterinarian Clinic is also very friendly, compassionate, and caring.

I have been to a few veterinary clinics in the area, and I am someone who always trusts my instincts. I feel very comfortable bringing Chloe here and highly recommend Dr. Jassal and his team to anyone looking for excellent, compassionate care for their pet.

Wonderful, caring doctor and staff. A full service clinic but one that doesn’t push you into extra tests or treatments just for the sake of it. They always try and provide different options. Possibly one of the last independent vets left in the city!

Whenever I talk to people about my experiences with veterinarians I always highly recommend Toronto Veterinary Clinic. They are absolutely the best! I never feel rushed. They always spend whatever time is necessary with me and my dog. Veterinarians and staff alike are  professional, effective, warm and welcoming. I would never consider going anywhere else. I have had negative experiences with other veterinarians, but never one time at Toronto Veterinarian Clinic. I recommend them highly. They don't push unnecessary services and they try to save you money too. They are top notch in every way!
Toronto Veterinary Clinic is my go-to place for taking care of my pet because they are knowledgeable and the staff are very friendly and cooperative.
Exceptional care for my pets. Open and honest feedback.  Very knowledgeable and a warm and welcoming environment.  You will not be disappointed ♥️
Best clinic, they are so thorough and helpful with everything. Will be my go to for as long as needed :) thankyou!

I struggled to find an adequate vet in Canada until I found this veterinary clinic. Dr Bick has been a blessing, and I can’t be happier to finally find the professionals who truly care about your pet and give you all the options to make these visits as peaceful as possible for your pet and you as a pet owner. I have a bengal male cat, who had never had a good relationship with vets, he gets very very stressed and aggressive, and I was told that the only way to even give him vaccines was through intramuscular sedation, which is nuts. Dr Bick took his time to understand my cat’s behaviour, to give him space and he gave me options that we could start with to avoid the sedation, and guess what, it worked! In my previous clinic when I asked for other options, they didn’t even entertain any other possibility. I can’t recommend Toronto Veterinary Clinic more, especially if vet visits is a huge stress for you and your pet. They truly do their best, and they truly work on finding the right approach for your pet, not just generic procedures. Thank you so much for making vet visits better!

I have only excellent experiences !
All staff are thoughtful, compassionate, and extremely competent. My dog Winston and I have no hesitation going ro seek help when needed. Winston definitely has no hesitation going to their office and that’s a good sign as well! 6 ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Absolutely love this place! I’ve been through a few vets throughout the years with my pets and this is hands down the best place. The team genuinely cares about my dogs well being, they never upsell us and always make us feel like our best interest is at heart. My dog looks forward to his visits! 10/10
Thanks, Youkii, for trusting us with your pet's care! ❤️

Doesn't actually care about the animals, will ommit knowledge even when asked directly. Lots of upsales while fear mongering affordable brands. Doesn't really listen to your concerns, pretends too, but then acts as if nothing was said. Just overall feels like their in it for the money.
This is an amazing place!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Francia. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Christina. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

Thy absolute most amazing vet ... my baby girl was extremely sick ... the vet waited a whole month to be paid knowing I was looking at anemergency surgery bill... completely devastated I felt just as cared for as  my furry bestie!!  ... appointments are always quick and the staff is amazing
Very caring vet, patient and compassionate and take great care of my senior dog

They killed my cat. Brought my cat there because his tooth was loose. They couldn't perform the surgery there so they had to refer me th a dental specialist. It took two weeks to get a call from the specialist. In that two weeks my cat suffered . He stopped eating and drinking because of that I could not administer his pain pills , antibiotics and Insulin. He ended up passing because of it. WHATEVER YOU DO DO NOT BRING YOUR OET TO THIS VET IF THEY NEED DENTAL WORK. THIS VET KILLED MY CAT.

Telly has been a loyal client to to Toronto Veterinary Clinic since we adopted her in July 2024. The staff are always so friendly and helpful and Telly is always excited for a visit to the vet! Whether it be for checkups, vaccines, anal gland issues, or anything else-- they always treat her very well. The pricing is fair and the service is excellent. Telly gives 5 stars

I am extremely disappointed with my visit to Toronto Veterinary Clinic. Yesterday, I spoke with the clinic and specifically confirmed that they provide dental services and have a veterinarian who handles dental issues and tooth extractions for cats. That was the whole reason for my appointment.

However, when I arrived, it turned out that there was no dental doctor available at all, and they could not provide the treatment we discussed beforehand. This was a complete waste of time and very misleading.

On top of that, I was still charged $142 just for a basic examination of my cat, despite not receiving the dental help we came for. If the clinic does not actually have a dental specialist available, this should be clearly communicated before booking appointments.

Very frustrating experience and poor communication.

Took my 7 month old Kitten in for a small exam and to see about 3 bumps on her back leg. Tiyu and Jaden were very friendly during intake and initial exam. Dr. Bick was also very friendly and took no time at all to figure out the 3 bumps and explain them. Also didnt even have to pay the full fee for an exam because it was nothing serious. Absolutely amazing experience my first time there and will be a Client there from now on. Highly recommend.

So, I’m generally hesitant to write reviews about places that aren’t restaurants. The reason I’m hesitant here is different—a good vet is hard to find, a great vet is even harder, and in Toronto, a fantastic vet clinic with amazing staff, strong customer service, and reasonable prices feels almost impossible, so I would selfishly want to keep this place to myself.

Given what’s happening in veterinary care—with large corporations buying out smaller practices and dramatically increasing prices—I feel this review is warranted.

We’ve been to Toronto Veterinary Clinic twice now: once for an incident with our dog, and the second time for his annual checkup and vaccines. On the first visit, they could have easily recommended a long list of tests, but they didn’t. Instead, the vet suggested monitoring him and even followed up with a call a few days later to check in. Having the experience and integrity to avoid unnecessary tests really stood out.

The second visit was for the usual annual care. I saw Dr. Jassal, and he was great to speak with. It’s very clear he genuinely cares about animals. He was excellent with our dog and didn’t rush the appointment—he took the time to explain what to watch for and how to prevent bigger (and more expensive) issues down the line.

Overall, we honestly wish we had found this clinic years ago. The staff are great with animals, and our dog was treated really well.

If you’re considering switching vets, or you’re in the Humber Bay area and looking for one, I think you’ll be very happy with this place.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Jack. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

Amazing family run & owned practice where you can feel the difference in the level of care and attention vs the clinics owned by the big corporations. They are also one of the most competitively priced in the GTA and you never feel upsold. After leaving another vet after many years, Dr Bic and his family are like a breath of fresh air where you can fully trust their level of service.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Nadiya. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

We started bringing our kitten Leo here in February and have been back several times since for his vaccinations and neutering. Dr. Jassal and the entire team have been consistently kind, professional, and genuinely caring not just toward Leo, but toward us as pet parents too. The staff is knowledgeable, gentle, and patient, and we've always felt confident in the care Leo receives. He’s never come home stressed or “off,” which speaks volumes about how they handle their furry patients. If you’re looking for a vet clinic in the area that treats both pets and people with compassion and respect, I highly recommend this one.
Thank you for your review!
The staff here are all incredible. Especially Tyson who works at the front desk, he was extremely kind and patient! : )
Very trustworthy professionals. Respectful with your budget. Caring with the patients. Family owned and operated. Great neighborhood clinic!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Everyone and everything was perfect
Made the appointment for Jackie very easy
Very nice place. Doctor and stuffs are very friendly and helpful.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

I highly recommend this clinic. I brought my little kitten here after I could not get an appointment anywhere else, on the same day. I was so pleased with the service and their pricing. Just on a side note I called around 2-3 other veterinary clinics in my area and all their initial appointment fees were at least $20 more then the Toronto Veterinary Clinic.

Everybody there was so extremely helpful, especially DR HARMEET JASSAL. He was honest, accommodating and made this mama finally feel like I found a vet - my original vet retired after 35 years, almost 5 years ago. I HIGHLY recommend the Toronto Veterinary Clinic if you're looking for someone you can trust with your furry children!

Toronto Veterinary Clinic may be a small practice, but what it lacks in size it more than makes up for in care and integrity. The clinic is always clean and well-maintained, and the staff genuinely care about the animals they treat.

Both Dr. Bick and Dr. Harmeet are wonderful to work with. They take the time to explain things clearly, answer questions, and make sure you feel comfortable with your pet’s care. You never feel rushed or pressured.

What really stands out about Toronto Veterinary Clinic is their honesty. Unlike some veterinary clinics in Toronto that seem focused on upselling services or charging for every possible add-on, this clinic gives thoughtful recommendations based on what your pet actually needs. It’s refreshing to find a vet that prioritizes the wellbeing of animals over maximizing the bill.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy, caring veterinary clinic in Toronto, this is a great place to bring your pet.

I took my dog for the first time here for an eye infection. By the end of the visit I decided to switch over his vet to the Toronto vet clinic. The vet techs and the vets are so friendly and knowledgeable. I didn’t feel like anything extra was being pushed on me which seems to be more common than not. They also gave my dog so much loving to make him feel comfortable. I am so so pleased with the service given to me and my dog here. Highly recommend!

We are so incredibly grateful for the wonderful care our dog Oreo received. From the moment we walked in, we felt that he was in kind, caring, and attentive hands. The compassion and understanding shown to both Oreo and our family truly meant so much to us. It’s clear how much you genuinely care about the animals you treat. Thank you for taking such thoughtful care of our sweet boy.

I have taken my dog to this clinic for various concerns and have always had a wonderful experience. The staff are extremely warm and caring and the coat of services is reasonable. I would highly recommend Toronto Veterinary Clinic to other pet owners!

We came to this clinic for the first time for a check-up in order to get a Cytopoint injection. The clinic policy states that if you are a new patient, all procedures must first go through a doctor’s examination. During that check-up, the doctor said HE WAS AFRAID MY DOG MIGHT BITE HIM and was afraid to check his teeth and oral cavity. For context, my dog weighs only 4 pounds.

Today was our second visit with a different doctor because I wanted to schedule a dental cleaning. Over the phone, I was told that we needed to meet with the doctor again before proceeding. During the visit, this doctor also said HE WAS AFRAID MY DOG MIGHT BITE HIM and asked me to hold him. I explained that when my dog feels support from me, he can become more protective and reactive, but if I step away, the vet can examine him calmly. The doctor responded that IF MY DOG FELL OFF THE TABLE, HE WOULD NOT TAKE RESPONSIBILITY.

We came to this clinic for the first time for a check-up in order to get a Cytopoint injection. The clinic policy states that if you are a new patient, all procedures must first go through a doctor’s examination. During that check-up, the doctor said HE WAS AFRAID MY DOG MIGHT BITE HIM and was afraid to check his teeth and oral cavity. For context, my dog weighs only 4 pounds.

At the end of the first visit, they referred me to another clinic, saying they are more professional and better equipped. They told me that HERE, DURING A TOOTH EXTRACTION, THEY COULD BREAK HIS JAW.

Today was our second visit with a different doctor because I wanted to schedule a dental cleaning. Over the phone, I was told that we needed to meet with the doctor again before proceeding. During the visit, this doctor also said HE WAS AFRAID MY DOG MIGHT BITE HIM and asked me to hold him. I explained that when my dog feels support from me, he can become more protective and reactive, but if I step away, the vet can examine him calmly. The doctor responded that IF MY DOG FELL OFF THE TABLE, HE WOULD NOT TAKE RESPONSIBILITY.

In the end, I had to handle most of it myself. Since my dog needs monthly Cytopoint injections for itching and I didn’t want to make another trip, I asked them to administer it the same day. Both the doctor and the nurse seemed afraid to even touch my 4-pound dog and ended up wrapping him in a towel. I have never seen this before in any other clinic just to give an injection.

Overall, this was a very disappointing and concerning experience.

Fantastic veterinary clinic, Both Dr. Bick and Harmeet Jassal are very kind and knowledgeable. The staff is all great and super helpful. I have gone in before with my cat for non-emergency issues and they were cared for and resolved. They have taken very good care of my moms cat as well.  This time I had a more serious and mysterious situation with my 13 year old cat, but Dr. Harmeet absolutely made all the right calls, consistently followed up by phone and I truly believe that thanks to that my cat is alive and well today. Thank you to all the staff and I would definetely recommend making this your primary clinic!
I have an especially anxious and difficult dog.  TVC are extremely patient and gracious with my dog and find great ways to take care of her.  I am very grateful.

This exceptional family-operated clinic consistently demonstrates a high level of expertise and professionalism. Their commitment to patient care is evident in their thorough explanations and attentive listening. The team's profound dedication is reflected in their personalized approach to animal treatment, mirroring the care given to their own pets. I wholeheartedly endorse their services and would award additional stars if the rating system allowed.

I had an appointment scheduled for 1:30 p.m., but by 2:10 p.m. we still hadn’t seen the doctor, only a technician. We decided to leave.
Appointments exist for a reason, and if the typical wait time is 40+ minutes, it raises the question of why scheduled appointments are offered at all. If managing the volume is difficult, perhaps a drop-in system would be more appropriate.

When veterinary visit costs are relatively similar across the GTA, I always choose clinics that respect my time.

P.S. The staff was friendly, and I have no concerns there. We didn’t proceed with any procedures due to time constraints, so I can’t comment on the medical care itself.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave this review, Ishan! 😊 …

Dr. Bick has been taking care of my French bulldog, Zoe, for the past year, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the care he provides. He is knowledgeable, thorough, and always takes the time to explain things clearly without rushing. Zoe can be a bit sensitive, and he’s always patient and gentle with her. It’s such a relief to have a veterinarian I truly trust — I highly recommend Dr. Bick to anyone looking for compassionate, reliable care for their pet.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

I'm very happy with the Toronto Veterinary Clinic. I have 2 cats (a senior & kitten), and everyone there is honestly so nice. They are knowledgeable while able to explain things clearly, clear with what procedures they recommend, and transparent with the pricing. I don't feel rushed or pressured whether its a checkup or emergency visit. And I've had no problems scheduling an appointment in a timely manner.
Thank you for giving best care to my Sengey.

All of the staff at Toronto Veterinary Clinic are extremely welcoming, friendly, and helpful. Having a number of vets across the city/province this one truly takes the gold medal.

The vets focus on fully understanding symptoms through thorough assessments, provide clear options with recommendations, and take the time to advise on overall health.

The team is also incredibly proactive with follow-ups — it’s the small things that really stand out.

I’ve never once felt rushed here. The vets genuinely care, and I’ve been very fortunate to have Bick assess our Labrador on multiple occasions — friendly, highly knowledgeable, and pragmatic in his approach.

They also don’t oversell or price gouge, which is refreshing compared to many other clinics in the city.

Toronto Veterinary Clinic — what great looks like!
Everyone is always so sweet and welcoming, they really make my dog Senna feel safe and cared for.

From start to finish, my visit with my dog Belle was a wonderful experience. Dr. Bick Jassal was kind, knowledgeable, and made the visit smooth and stress-free from start to finish. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and very helpful, making the whole experience even better. I would highly recommend them. 🐾 …

I’ve been a client of Toronto Vet Clinic for just over a year now and I highly recommend it. Dr. Jassal is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and takes the time to explain everything clearly, which makes such a difference as a pet owner. You can truly tell how much he cares about the animals he treats. My dog always receives excellent care, and I always feel confident and reassured leaving the clinic.

Thank you Toronto Vet Clinic and Dr. Jassal!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Very kind warm people. They make your pet feel safe and secure. Trustworthy and don't try to sell to you. They also don't try to money gouge!

We were recommended to this vet by another frenchie owner we met on a walk and we are very grateful to have found this vet clinic! We have an anxious frenchie who does not like going to the vet and while a few other vets had a lot of trouble giving him vaccines and completing blood work this clinic knew exactly how to handle it  and were able to complete everything needed without sedation medication which many other vets needed to use. Great for pets who are more anxious at the vet!

Amazing vet! We went here in an emergency and then switched vets to them. The Dr is so patient and wants to do the best for your pet. He follows up more than I do, you can tell he really cares. The team that works there is also great. There is a parking lot infront which helps.

I moved to the area and was very happy with this clinic. The doctor is very personable and spent time explaining things to me and going over medication and follow up plans. My previous vet would pop in at some point the have his staff take over the rest. I appreciate that this wasn't the case. The support staff were incredibly kind as well and you can tell they are true animal lovers.  Highly recommend

The doctor is very professional, friendly, and patient.
I brought my cat to the clinic because he had been scratching his ear. After examining him, Dr. Bick confirmed that everything was fine and also shared some additional information about feline urinary health.
The veterinarian and the staff are amazing they have treated us and my baby girl Lily so wonderfully I would highly recommend to anyone

We moved to the vet clinic from another clinic that was all about money. Our experience with this clinic has been great! Dr  Harmeet & Dr Bick always have gentle handling of our baby! They have reasonable prices and honest advice which is a refreshing change from the other clinics we have visited in the past. We wholly recommend this clinic.
Great service, was recommended a new diet and my dog didn’t like it, they had ko problem returning it, friendly and helpful!

Upon my urgent panic to get my pup some extra help in what felt like a dire emergency, I’m glad I came to this specific vet. This clinic is everything you hope to find when you’re trusting someone with your fur baby’s health. Being a family run veterinary practice, there’s a trust you can feel the moment you walk in. You can tell they care as much as you do.

What I appreciate most is their honesty and knowledge, even when it means you’re willing to take out a second mortgage for your pet. They never try to sell you on anything unnecessary or push extra tests “just because.” Dr. Bick explained everything clearly, make sure I understood my best options, and always put my pet’s well-being first. It’s rare to find a veterinarian who is both skilled and genuinely ethical.

Their responsiveness is incredible. They answered and fulfilled my request to be seen urgently.
